body.text: KAIROS PHYSICAL THERAPY PLLC matches the submitted business name, and the IRS holds a record for the submitted TIN under that name.
No tax or UCC liens were found against KAIROS PHYSICAL THERAPY PLLC.
SORENSON COMMUNICATIONS, LLC matches the submitted business name. No TIN is on file for this business, so the TIN match had nothing to check.

There are 2 of 15 liens that are open. One is a 2024 Utah UCC filing held by Oaktree Fund Administration; the other is a $126.13 State of Indiana lien from 2025. The remaining 13 are closed UCC filings from 2006 to 2019, nearly all naming lenders as collateral agents.
